# Implementation Planning Stage Rules

- Order work by dependency and note which pieces can run in parallel.
- Include explicit handoffs for Development, Review, QA, and Deployment.
- Turn verification and deployment work into named tasks instead of implicit follow-up.
- List blockers, assumptions, and required inputs for each task before implementation starts.
- Keep the plan tied to the approved architecture and the active story scope.
- Describe how the implementation will be validated and what evidence will be collected for the next stage.
